comparison.objective: Remove a spring-loaded bayonet sleeve through a hidden multistage track and place it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual push-turn-lift-turn-pull sequencing against a spring and hidden ledges.
comparison.success_condition: Sleeve fully removed through the required sequence and deposited in the tray; damage and numeric thresholds are unspecified.
comparison.reason: Shares removal and tray placement only generically; its tested ability is continuous hidden-track coupling disengagement, not controlled notch fracture followed by recovery of four millimetre-scale fragments.
